activation_condition: Independent acceptance by parent workflow of the selected root contrast as a counterexample; no approval is issued here.
conclusion: Reduced profiles motivate transient evolution but do not identify a defensible predictive closure. Additional retained-field calibration is required before commitment or validation.
mechanism: Local transient transverse compression opposed by resistive broadening, with a shared flux-stage upstream-supply closure.

observable.flux: supplied initial-state-subtracted boundary-to-center By path; same sign and normalization
observable.crossing: first linear crossing in actual saved time

initial_conditions.w: w0 from common initial field; not validation measured

model.width_definition: h is first outward half-amplitude crossing; sigma=h/0.6744897501960817
model.prediction: Integrate from t=0 with eta=1/S_eta; predict both first crossings; duration=T(0.05)-T(0.01); rate=0.04/duration.
model.model_status: Kinematic candidate closure; not derived full compressible MHD dynamics; omitted EMF must be tested.

calibration.source_policy: Fresh retained full-state anchor snapshots only; use finest independently qualified mesh and preceding mesh. Pending 512 not presumed successful.
fixing_procedure: Hash initial state and both actual crossing-bracket full states for each nonzero knot; interpolate diagnostics by actual flux bracket weights.
Use independently defined half-amplitude h. Regress vy-vy(0)=-a*y, unweighted over |y|<=h, after averaging two central x columns.
At each knot arithmetic-mean a and B_u between anchors. Set w0 to mean of their initial sigma squared. Piecewise-linear interpolation versus flux, no extrapolation.
All calibration gates must pass; no rate rescaling, eta-dependent coefficient or knot insertion.
Replay both calibration anchors and publish coefficient table and numeric predictions, with hashes, before viewing either new setting.

gates.dimensionless_strain_definition: (a_anchor-a_mean)*sqrt(w_mean)/v_A_u; v_A_u=B_u/sqrt(rho_u) using peak-position density and side/anchor means
gates.zero_velocity_fit_rule: exactly zero measured and fitted profiles pass; nonzero measured with zero fit fails
gates.omitted_terms: longitudinal current and boundary/ideal EMF; integrate absolute magnitudes in supplied path sign convention; inspect more retained frames if needed

calibration.on_failure: End this candidate before validation; a replacement needs its own prospective proposal.

numerical_allowances.rate_uncertainty_rule: max(0.01,2*max(last two relative mesh changes)+full crossing-bracket relative deviation+orthogonal-path relative rate difference+measured CFL relative rate difference)
numerical_allowances.topology: single-sheet pre-plasmoid; full-domain resolved 1X2O through actual upper crossing bracket, with sampled-resolution limitations
numerical_allowances.uncertainty_type: deterministic empirical numerical allowance, not a statistical confidence interval
numerical_allowances.new_eta_controls_required: Do not assume anchor envelopes apply to new eta.

failure_and_survival.rate_falsifier: At least one admissible numerically qualified new case has observed duration interval disjoint from its frozen prediction interval.
failure_and_survival.two_case_survival: Both qualified observed duration intervals wholly contained in their respective prediction intervals; limited to these two settings.
failure_and_survival.field_falsifier: Definitely greater than 0.15 relative discrepancy in predicted h or B_u at any declared knot, with diagnostic error bounded <=0.05, refutes field closure even if rate matches.
failure_and_survival.closure_gate_failure: A definitely exceeded omitted-flux or strain gate in an otherwise admissible trajectory refutes that assumption.
failure_and_survival.out_of_scope_or_unqualified: Inconclusive for rate law; report regime/numerical failure separately.

minimal_discriminating_diagnostic.deliverable: Hashed transverse and longitudinal cuts at initial and knot brackets; strain, half-amplitude width, B supply, rho,p, longitudinal current and endpoint EMF.
minimal_discriminating_diagnostic.scope_limit: Three nonzero stages cannot bound an integrated omitted EMF or rapid temporal variation; use more already retained frames if initial gates survive.
minimal_discriminating_diagnostic.reason_not_performed: Full-state fields are absent from the supplied packet.

budget.scope: Two-run budget is screening only unless numerical controls already justify new settings; additional controls and possible 512 are not included in headline.
limitations: Lower S may be diffusion-step limited.
Archive size and runtime at new eta are estimates.
No future runtime or storage allocation is authorized by this proposal.

unsupported_assumptions: Common upstream B_u(psi) despite finite-box and compressible evolution.
Gaussian local shape and width evolution closure.
Negligible longitudinal and boundary/ideal EMF contributions.
Initial state reducible to a single width.
Sparse flux-stage knots resolve relevant history.
actions_performed: Read supplied files, verify hashes, reduce profiles and crossing times, estimate costs; no simulations, solver edits, external study imports, scientific approvals or agents.
